verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at bulk data movement. Tables are defined with Apache Arrow schemas, Lance-format datasets on the Hugging Face Hub can be scanned directly via hf:// URIs, and a community comment references LanceDB's read_and_write docs. Query results can be pulled out as arrays or Pydantic objects, but nothing documents bulk-import or bulk-export workflows or supported file formats for vectors plus metadata. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-ingest docs (e.g., Parquet/CSV/Arrow/pandas batch loading), documented bulk-export/full-table dump paths and formats, independent or hands-on corroboration of large-scale import/export.
